tasks.name: demo
tasks.description: 演示编译日志词汇翻译

cmd.desc: 输出典型编译日志行 → 右侧实时 log 看中文翻译效果
cmd.cmd: echo 'Compiling editor/editor_node.cpp ...'; echo 'Compiling editor/gui/string_builder.cpp ...'; echo 'Generating editor/file_type_cache.cpp'; echo 'WARNING: msgfmt execution failed'; echo "editor/main.cpp:12:5: error: 'foo' was not declared"; echo 'scons: Building targets ...'; echo 'Linking program bin/Debug/cloud_main'; echo 'scons: done building targets.'

ui.title: ab — 翻译效果演示
ui.prompt:
右侧实时 log 窗口可看到 Compiling/WARNING 等词汇的中文翻译 (文件名/路径保持原样).
菜单 [视图] → [语言] 可切换 中文/English, 选择后自动保存到 ~/.config/ai_tools/lang.json.
